address_family.description: Specify which address family to use when connecting (any, inet, inet6).

add_keys_to_agent.description: Specify whether keys should be automatically added to a running ssh-agent (no, yes, ask, confirm, or time interval).

batch_mode.description: If set to yes, user interaction such as password prompts will be disabled.

canonicalize_hostname.description: Controls whether explicit hostname canonicalization is performed (no, yes, always).

ca_signature_algorithms.description: Specifies which algorithms are allowed for signing of certificates by CAs, comma-separated.

ciphers.description: Specifies the ciphers allowed and their order of preference, comma-separated.

check_host_ip.description: If set to yes, ssh will additionally check the host IP address in the known_hosts file.

control_master.description: Enables the sharing of multiple sessions over a single network connection (no, yes, ask, auto, autoask).

control_path.description: Specify the path to the control socket used for connection sharing.

control_persist.description: Specifies that the master connection should remain open in the background (no, yes, 0, or time).

fingerprint_hash.description: Specifies the hash algorithm used when displaying key fingerprints (md5, sha256).

forward_agent.description: Specifies whether the connection to the authentication agent will be forwarded.

forward_x11.description: Specifies whether X11 connections will be automatically redirected over the secure channel.

gssapi_authentication.description: Specifies whether user authentication based on GSSAPI is allowed.

hash_known_hosts.description: Indicates that ssh should hash host names and addresses when they are added.

host_key_algorithms.description: Specifies the host key signature algorithms that the client wants to use, comma-separated.

hostname_default.description: Specifies the real host name to log into as a global default (usually overridden per Host block or command line).

identity_files.description: Specifies files from which the user's authentication identity is read. List of file paths (e.g., ~/.ssh/id_ed25519). Order matters; first match wins for authentication unless IdentitiesOnly is used.

kbd_interactive_authentication.description: Specifies whether to use keyboard-interactive authentication.

kex_algorithms.description: Specifies the available KEX (Key Exchange) algorithms, comma-separated.

log_level.description: Gives the verbosity level that is used when logging messages (QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG, DEBUG1, DEBUG2, DEBUG3).

macs.description: Specifies the MAC (message authentication code) algorithms in order of preference, comma-separated.

number_of_password_prompts.description: Specifies the number of password prompts before giving up.

password_authentication.description: Specifies whether to use password authentication.

port.description: Specifies the port number to connect on the remote host.

preferred_authentications.description: Specifies the order in which the client should try authentication methods, comma-separated.

pubkey_authentication.description: Specifies whether to try public key authentication.

server_alive_count_max.description: Sets the number of server alive messages which may be sent without receiving any back.

server_alive_interval.description: Sets a timeout interval in seconds after which if no data has been received, ssh will send a message.

strict_host_key_checking.description: If set to yes, ssh will never automatically add host keys to the known_hosts file (yes, no, ask, accept-new).

syslog_facility.description: Gives the facility code that is used when logging messages (DAEMON, USER, AUTH, LOCAL0-LOCAL7).

tcp_keepalive.description: Specifies whether the system should send TCP keepalive messages to the other side.

user.description: Specifies the user to log in as.
